title: Pointwise basic-open detection from the fraction formula
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], L an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], S its graded section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring], and f:X -> Proj(S) [def-pc-proj]. Assume that for each homogeneous s of positive degree d, every n >= 0 and every homogeneous xi of degree nd, on f^{-1}(D_+(s)) one has f^sharp(xi/s^n) s^n = xi, as an identity of restricted tensor-power sections. Let x in X admit a positive-degree homogeneous section t which is nonvanishing at x [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. For every homogeneous s of positive degree, f(x) lies in D_+(s) if and only if s is nonvanishing at x. Only the point x is required to lie outside the base locus.

The fraction pullback identity for a morphism into Proj implies that a point is in the inverse image of a homogeneous basic open exactly when the corresponding invertible module section does not vanish
